title: Text animations
summary: Title cards and text overlays in light: tracked Michroma capitals that land saturated orange, burn through red and cool to white, always arriving where a line of light reaches them. Title cards start with the red dot top-left firing the first line, on near-black and deep teal haze.
usage: Title cards fill the frame (any shape from square to 9:16): use one as a shot's "background", e.g. {"background": {"piece": "text/headline-slam", "props": {"lines": ["YOUR", "WORDS"], "field": "teal"}}}, or as a footage "cutaway". Fields: teal (default), black, deep, ember, violet (field names from other themes are mapped onto these). Overlays are see-through, in 1080×1920 frame pixels: {"piece": "text/keyword-slam", "start": 1.2, "end": 3.4, "props": {"word": "LISTEN", "y": 330}}. Every word and position is a prop; props match the other themes so storyboards can switch. Kit: library/themes/lines-of-light/kit.js. Files: library/themes/lines-of-light/text/pieces/.

items.name: Headline
items.description: The red dot fires down and across into an underline that opens both ways; the headline lands over it line by line (orange, red, white) in a blue flash, with a sunburst rising from a horizon low in the frame.

items.name: Split stack
items.description: Two words either side of a line of light: the top word lands as the line draws, a red pulse runs it, and the bottom word lands in a blue flash where the pulse arrives.

items.name: Drifting rows
items.description: Rows of phrases drifting past each other in dim tracked capitals under hairlines of light; one row at a time comes up orange to white and settles back.

items.name: Statement
items.description: A sentence beside a vertical rule of light: each line lands as the rule draws past it; the emphasis words land last with an underline opening from their centre.

items.name: Big number
items.description: A figure inside a dial of light: the ring opens from where the red line touches it, ticks draw out, the digits roll and land, a blue flash locks it.

items.name: Quote
items.description: Quote marks drawn in light, a rule down the left of the quote landing it line by line, the source under a short rule with a mono role.

items.name: Agenda
items.description: A numbered list on a spine of light: a triple bar reaches each item in turn and the item lands beside it.

items.name: Versus
items.description: A diagonal line of light splits two sides; a ring opens round VS where it passes the middle; a red pulse runs it and the second side lands in a blue flash.

items.name: Chapter
items.description: A track of light past a row of stops; the current chapter's stop opens and flashes blue, then the number lands large with the title below.

items.name: Countdown
items.description: Numbers landing inside a dial whose ring draws round as each second runs out, a red dot travelling the rim; GO bursts into a sunburst and a blue flash.

items.name: End card
items.description: A small ring with a plus opens where the red line touches it, a sunburst of uneven rays blinks blue, then the call to action and handle land below.

items.name: Keyword
items.description: One word over the footage between two lines of light: a red dot fires the line above, the one below opens from the centre, the word lands in a blue flash.

items.name: Highlight
items.description: A sentence over the footage; a line of light draws under the marked words and a red pulse runs it, landing each marked word as it passes.

items.name: Lower third
items.description: A red dot fires a line under the name, a short vertical opens at its end, the name lands and the role types in mono.

items.name: Side text
items.description: Text running up or down the frame edge beside a line of light fired by a red dot, with a mono line on the far side.

items.name: Band
items.description: Moving text between two lines of light that open from the centre across the frame, with a mono strip running the other way.

items.name: Corner labels
items.description: Four small labels under corner brackets of light that open from their corners; the top-left carries the red dot.

items.name: Picture frame
items.description: A frame of light for a screenshot or second clip, opening both ways from where the red line touches it, with a label above and a caption below.

items.name: Badge
items.description: A ring of light opening round a point, a short sunburst, a mono ring of text turning inside and a word landing in the middle.
